description: An explosive fire engulfed a bar in Thailand’s capital, killing at least 28 people and injuring dozens more. description: Grand Erie Public Health is reminding former patients of Dr. George Chan Dentistry in Brantford, Ont., to get tested for hepatitis B, hepatitis C and HIV.
